newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIA LATE PALM OLEIN EDGES UP ON DEMAND.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIA LATE PALM OLEIN EDGES UP ON DEMAND.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices extended gains in late trading on Thursday as buyers continued to swarm the market amid tight supply, traders said.

They said palm olein was mostly quoted at 1,465-70 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, up from 1,460-65 rupiah at the opening and 1,445-50 rupiah at Wednesday's close. A crude palm oil tender is scheduled for Friday in the north Sumatran city of Medan.
"Demand kept on coming, and some players stopped selling in anticipation of more gains tomorrow," one trader said. "Some sellers seem to be out of oil at the moment."
Traders said the tight supply was the result of exports increasing on improved prices in Europe and the lowering of the export tax on palm olein in early July.

"Prices are continuing to go higher because of the good demand," one trader said. "Supply of ready palm olein is tight, and is expected to get tighter because prices in Europe are getting better and exports will increase," one added.
